Sincerely,

Hohng LLC

Sincerely,

Hohng LLC.

notes.title: Cubistry is now free to play!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. We're happy to announce that Cubistry has now been made free to play on Steam. This is the beginning of a transition for Cubistry. Cubistry will soon become "The Istrys" on Steam where previously released Istrys will be playable for free along side new Istrys which will be made available to play for a period of time before becoming a part of the cross-platform subscriptions based service for The Istrys and more which we will be rolling out sometime next year. Thank you for your patience while we go through this transitional period and please enjoy all the free content we will be releasing in the weeks to come. Thank you.

Sincerely,

Hohng LLC

notes.title: Toggle on/off cube mismatch sound.
notes.notes:
Hello! We're happy to announce that we just pushed an update which makes it possible to turn the mismatch sound on and off. Please look for the option in the Settings screen.

You will also see another setting which only plays custom sounds when matches are made. This setting doesn't affect Cubistry since Cubistry plays the Istrys default selection sound when selecting a single cube but for other Istrys this setting will make it so selecting a cube will play the default Istrys selection sound then play the mismatch sound if mismatch sounds are on. If mismatch sounds are off and custom sounds always is chosen then selecting a cube will play the custom cube selection sounds even if a mismatch is made. We will be rolling this out to all currently released Istrys on Steam shortly. Enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

Sincerely,

Hohng LLC.

notes.title: WASD controls!
notes.notes:
We're happy to report that keyboard controls have been added to Cubistry for both single player and multiplayer modes! Player 1 can use the WASD keys to rotate their cubes while Player 2 can use the arrow keys and the 2, 4, 6, and 8 keys on the numpad to rotate their cubes.

Additionally, it is possible to reset the camera using the keyboard as well. Player 1 can use the space key to reset their camera while Player 2 can use the right ctrl key and the 5 key on the numpad to reset their camera.

But that is not all. We've also added mouse and keyboard sensitivity sliders in the Controls screen so you can tweak the controls to just the way you like them. We will be rolling out this update to all currently released Istrys on Steam in the next several days. Enjoy and happy istrying! ːsteamhappyː

Sincerely,

Hohng LLC

notes.title: You can now choose how you'd like to zoom in and out.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. We would like to let everyone know that it is now possible to switch how zooming in and out works. By default scrolling the mouse scroll wheel down zooms out the cubes. If however you'd like the cubes to zoom out by scrolling the mouse scroll wheel up, then you can go into the controls screen through the settings screen and select the "Scroll up to zoom out" button to do just that. Thanks for playing the Istrys and enjoy!

notes.title: Zoom in and out using the mouse scroll wheel!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. We're happy to announce that player are now able to zoom in and out in games by rolling the mouse scroll wheel up and down. Roll the mouse scroll wheel down to zoom out and up to zoom in. You zoom is then saved between games and sessions so you don't have to zoom in and out after every game. Both single-player and multiplayer modes are supported. Enjoy!

Hohng LLC
